development.constructibility_fail: If fewer than20 eligible after fixed64 scan: INCONCLUSIVE_GROUNDED_PAIR_CONSTRUCTIBILITY; causal grid not evaluated.
development.selection: A4 endpoint selects one global layer/alpha by frozen old action-matched tie-break; A5/B5 co-primary evaluated at exact same point with no reselection.

grounded_pair_construction.branch_action5: Clone the exact common post-action3 state. Execute A4 and B4 separately. In each actual branch-local state, score current admissible nontrivial commands with the same frozen executor scorer and choose greedy rank1 as A5/B5. Require both valid and A5 != B5; otherwise family is constructibility-ineligible with no retry/replacement.
grounded_pair_construction.branch_candidates: At the actual common post-action3 state, score every admissible nontrivial action with the same frozen executor scorer. Require >=2. Take deterministic rank1 and rank2 as the unordered branch-action set.
grounded_pair_construction.freeze_before_causal: Persist action strings/token IDs, executor scores/ranks, common/branch observations, admissible command sets, state hashes, orientation bit, and construction provenance before source-plan capture or any activation intervention/outcome.
grounded_pair_construction.orientation: Assign unordered rank1/rank2 to labels A/B by SHA256("PlanCarry|ACTION_MATCHED_GROUNDED_V2|ORIENT|{game_path}").digest()[0] & 1. Thus A/B sign is independent of intrinsic rank; persist orientation bit and both un-oriented ranks/scores.
grounded_pair_construction.shared_action3: At cut2 score CURRENT admissible nontrivial commands with the frozen executor suffix-logprob scorer and choose exact greedy argmax with lexical tie-break. Execute shared action3 only in a construction clone to obtain actual observation3/admissibles3.

interpretation.causal_pass_future: If later untouched confirmation passes ACTIVE beyond controls including FUTURE_ACTION_SEQUENCE_ONLY, supports a semantic grounded plan-state carrier beyond exact future action tokens. If ACTIVE beats next-action-only but not future-action-sequence-only, scope is future action-sequence state rather than semantic plan language.
interpretation.constructibility_pass: Only establishes grounded-pair feasibility for causal development.
interpretation.fail: Development null/futility does not authorize changing population, construction rank rule, plan-realization prompt, layers/alphas, controls, or thresholds on consumed data.

motivation.use: constructibility diagnosis only; no causal evidence

plan_representation.action_sequence_control: FUTURE_ACTION_SEQUENCE_ONLY: exact canonical minimal token serialization of shared A3 plus branch A4/A5 versus shared A3 plus branch B4/B5, norm-matched to ACTIVE. It controls exact future-action identity without plan-language/rationale.
plan_representation.claim_scope: ACTIVE beating NEXT_DIVERGENT_ACTION_ONLY supports information beyond immediate A4 identity; ACTIVE beating FUTURE_ACTION_SEQUENCE_ONLY is required for any stronger semantic-plan-language claim. If it does not, claim is limited to grounded future action-sequence state.
plan_representation.construction: After grounded A3/A4/A5 and B3/B4/B5 action sequences freeze, make one deterministic plan-realization call per branch using only task/current pre-cut observable context plus the exact frozen three-action sequence; require one complete <PLAN>...</PLAN> block that explicitly contains the three frozen actions in order, max96 plan tokens, no future observation text. No retry. This call is representation materialization, not pair search.
plan_representation.next_divergent_action_control: NEXT_DIVERGENT_ACTION_ONLY preserves A4-vs-B4 identity and contains zero A5/B5-derived IDs.

prohibitions: No ActionMatched-v1 consumed paths or old future splits.
No activation outcome in pair construction/eligibility.
No pair regeneration/retry or post-outcome widening.
No claim that grounded construction is natural spontaneous planning; it is a controlled mechanistic plan-state test.

rank_naturality_confound_control.no_equal_plausibility_filter: No score-gap filter is allowed; avoids outcome-independent but selective naturality filtering and preserves fixed population.
rank_naturality_confound_control.no_patch_centering: All causal effects are arm-minus-NO_PATCH at the same frozen common state; intrinsic rank preference is therefore baseline-centered.
